description: A clean, modern, interactive price-graph overlay for Hypixel SkyBlock. In-game, without the blocky Minecraft UI.

mods.name: SkyQuant
mods.description: A clean, modern, interactive price-graph overlay for Hypixel SkyBlock. Hover an item (or /graph <name>) to open a draggable, resizable panel with Bazaar/Auction House prices and history. Powered by the Coflnet SkyBlock API.
